definition: In this context, a vowel is a speech sound examined through measurable acoustic features such as resonance patterns, speaking time, and consistency across attempts. Studying these features may help describe and track speech production differences in some autistic children, but current evidence does not support vowel measures as a general diagnostic marker for all ASD.
